programId: Earth & Space Sciences: Environmental Science AAS-DTA
label: to Transfer

recommendedOpportunity.name: Choose a course
recommendedOpportunity.description:
For Social Sciences, you will need to select courses from two different subjects. The following list includes courses that were selected by faculty and advisors in this area. You can choose a course from this list or you can choose a course from the complete list of Social Sciences courses found on the AAS-DTA degree worksheet. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options. 

Please note that you must take one course in either Social Sciences, Humanities, or Electives that fulfills the Diversity Degree Requirement (DDR) at some point in your degree. ANTH 220, CES 100, SOC& 101, and SOC 254 will fulfill the DDR requirement.

recommendedOpportunity.title: Meet with Academic Advisor
recommendedOpportunity.shortDescription: Set up an appointment this quarter
recommendedOpportunity.longDescription: It is important to set up an education plan that is specific to your goals. Every university and major will require slightly different prerequisites. It is highly recommended that you speak with a BC academic advisor to ensure you are meeting program, degree, and university transfer requirements.

recommendedOpportunity.name: Choose a course
recommendedOpportunity.description: Choose a course from the following options: ENGL 201 or ENGL& 235.

recommendedOpportunity.title: Transfer Milestone
recommendedOpportunity.longDescription: It is important to attend the transfer and information sessions offered by transfer institutions you are considering so you are familiar with the admissions requirements, expectations, deadlines, and areas of specialization. Please check the world language admissions and graduation requirements as these will vary with each school.

recommendedOpportunity.name: Choose a course
recommendedOpportunity.description: For Natural Sciences, you will need to select courses from two different subjects. The following list includes courses that were selected by faculty and advisors in this area. The Biology Sequence is recommended if you are considering fields such as conservation, ecology, resource management. The Chemistry Sequence is recommended if you are considering fields such as climate science, resource management, environmental chemistry. While dependent on the college or university, you will likely need to take both biology and chemistry courses for this field. Please consult an advisor or refer to the AAS-DTA degree worksheet to learn about additional course options.
